Bill.BriefDescription: Suspending certain collective bargaining agreements and administrative rules in the event of a disaster.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to suspending certain collective bargainingagreements and administrative rules in the event of a disaster; addinga new section to chapter 49.36 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter34.05 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In the event of a disaster, any collective bargaining agreemententered into on or after the effective date of this act shall besuspended to the extent necessary to: (a) Safely restore public utilities as quickly as possible; and (b) Provide emergency services to persons affected by the disaster. (2) For purposes of this section, "disaster" means any natural ormanmade condition that results in a declaration of emergency by acounty, the governor, or the president of the United States.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 34.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In the event of a disaster, all rules shall be suspended to theextent necessary to: (a) Safely restore public utilities as quickly as possible; and (b) Provide emergency services to persons affected by the disaster. (2) For purposes of this section, "disaster" means any natural ormanmade condition that results in a declaration of emergency by acounty, the governor, or the president of the United States.
